   140  `p`-radical if the following conditions are satisfied:
   141  
   142  - For any element `x` of `L` there is `n : ℕ` such that `x ^ (p ^ n)` is contained in `K`.
   143  - The kernel of `i` is contained in the `p`-nilradical of `K`.
   144  
   145  It is a generalization of purely inseparable extension for fields. -/
   146  @[mk_iff]
   147  class IsPRadical : Prop where
   148    pow_mem' : ∀ x : L, ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : K), i y = x ^ p ^ n
   149    ker_le' : RingHom.ker i ≤ pNilradical K p
